rootCause: Stale session product anchor (sessionContext.lastBestProduct) was treated as active product discussion in scanConversationForProductContext, causing resolveSemanticTarget to return PRODUCT via short_aesthetic_with_product_context before the MIA greeting path could apply. Taxonomy correctly identified compliment_to_mia (signals: compliment, mia_target) but semantic target resolution ignored it when session carried lastBestProduct.

incorrectExecution.validatorBehavior: correct per degraded contract — product_entity_on_mia_target only fires when target=mia

whyIntermittent: Only occurs when session_context carries stale lastBestProduct from prior commercial turn or polluted anchor; ~20% of B2 runs in production had session anchor present while conversation was purely social MIA greeting.
legacyEntityFrame: lib/miaSocialResponsePerception.js:buildEntityOpinionFallback (only via buildSpecificGovernedFallback — not used in chat-gpt4o pipeline)
replacementTraceGap: No replacement needed — response was semantically valid for the wrongly degraded product contract
